risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and generally transparent, with strong earnings, capital, liquidity, and credit metrics presented. Risk tone is broadly confident, but rising nonaccruals and nonperforming assets concentrated in oil and gas relationships, along with declining reserve coverage and net interest margin, indicate emerging credit and profitability pressures. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and positive characterizations somewhat temper the discussion of these risks.
